title: Uploaded nothing, instantly
hints: Log `report` right before the `return`. Then log it again inside the callback after `await upload(name)`. Which log appears first?

`forEach` calls your callback and ignores what it returns. An `async` callback returns a promise, so `forEach` starts every upload at once and nobody waits for any of them: the function returns its (still empty) report straight away.
Use a loop that the surrounding `async` function can pause in: replace `files.forEach(async (name) => {` with `for (const name of files) {` (and close it with `}` instead of `});`).
